about: Profile documents, their merge and the effective view, read by canoa (tests/profile.rs) and the app (app/test/profile_vectors_test.dart). Each layer is a TOML document; `effective` is the view both produce, or `error` the first refusal: its layer's index, a code, and for every code but parse the key it names. `sources` are AOS source strings held to what Canoa fetches. `overlays` are AOS overlays, each given as its files: the overlays refused whole, the view of their layers in composition order under an optional user layer, and the environment built from them over `host`, or the refusal. `loadouts` are canoa.cfg texts and the loadout a session names (null: none named): the loadout resolved against `[overlays]` (overlays in composition order, those `[overlays]` lacks apart, skills, servers), or null when none applies, or `error`: `unknown-loadout` with the name, or `invalid` when the file is refused. `presets` are canoa.cfg texts: the `[profiles.NAME]` presets they hold (only the settings each names), or `error`: `invalid` when the file is refused; with `use`, the view of the person's own `[profile]` under that preset as the session layer.

merges.name: all six layers: a later layer wins per key, lists merge by name, a layer removes an entry

layers.name: team
layers.toml:
model = "team-model"
effort = "medium"
context = { file = "CONTEXT.md" }
[env.GITHUB_TOKEN]
from_env = "GITHUB_TOKEN"
[skills.review]
path = "skills/review"
[mcp.docs]
type = "http"
url = "https://docs.example/mcp"

mode = "plan"
[env.RUST_LOG]
value = "debug"
[mcp.docs]
remove = true
[mcp.files]
type = "stdio"
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "server-files", "."]
[mcp.files.env.FILES_ROOT]
value = "."

overlays.name: no manifest: the root variable, a skill and CONTEXT.md; bin/ goes first on PATH
an env file, env, a path addition and MCP servers, under a user layer

files.overlay.cfg:
priority = 300

[env]
TOOL_MODE = "read-only"
TOOL_CONFIG = { path = "conf/tool.toml" }
TOOL_TOKEN = { provider = "env", key = "TOOL_TOKEN", optional = true }
TOOL_URL = "${TOOL_HOME}/api"

[[paths]]
variable = "MANPATH"
path = "man"

[[mcp.servers]]
name = "docs"
transport = "stdio"
command = "tools/server"
args = ["--quiet"]
env = { MODE = "x", KEY = { provider = "env", key = "DOCS_KEY" } }
env_passthrough = ["HOME_DIR"]
timeout = 30

[[mcp.servers]]
name = "remote"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "http://docs.example/mcp"
headers_env = { Authorization = "DOCS_AUTH" }

not_applied: mcp.docs: it runs in the overlay's root, which Canoa does not set yet

overlays.name: an overlay that sets a variable the specification reserves is left out whole, and the others stay
an overlay.cfg that is not valid is left out, naming the pointer
what Canoa does not apply is listed, and the hints of the agent's own harness apply

files.overlay.cfg:
routing = ["- Releases: read $TOOLS_OVERLAY_ROOT/kb/release.md"]

[scripts]
check = "bin/check.py"
old = false

[runtime]
os = ["linux", "windows"]

[[setup]]
interpreter = "sh"
path = "setup/install.sh"

[harness.claude-code]
model = "claude-opus-4-1"
effort = "high"
context = ["kb/claude.md"]
skills = false
permissions = "all"

[harness.codex]
effort = "low"

overlays.name: a required reference reads the variable of this computer, and is listed as a pass-through
a placeholder reads a variable of this computer
overlays in composition order: the higher priority wins, and its placeholders see what the lower one set
problems under [about] never stop an overlay, and Canoa applies nothing of it
OVERLAY.md: its YAML front matter is the manifest and its body is the context

Be brief.

overlays.name: OVERLAY.md: a format line names TOML, and a body of white space leaves CONTEXT.md the context
OVERLAY.md: a body is the context, and CONTEXT.md beside it is ignored and reported

files.OVERLAY.md:
---
env:
  TEAM_MODE: strict
---
From the body.

not_applied: context: CONTEXT.md, ignored while the body of OVERLAY.md is the context

overlays.name: OVERLAY.md: with no front matter all of it is the body
OVERLAY.md: its restricted YAML reads comments, flow and block collections, and quoted and block scalars

files.OVERLAY.md:
---
# a comment

routing: ["Read kb/x.md", 'and kb/y.md']

    two

overlays.name: OVERLAY.md and overlay.cfg in one overlay are refused, never merged
OVERLAY.md: an anchor, a tag and a merge key are refused
OVERLAY.md: front matter never closed, or a mapping that is not one, is refused
the delegation hint of the agent's own harness is read, and another harness's is not

loadouts.name: the default loadout holds its overlays in composition order, its skills and its servers
loadouts.config:
[overlays]
team = "https://example.invalid/team.git@main"
other = "https://example.invalid/other.git@main"
[loadouts.review]
description = "Reading code"
overlays = ["other", "team"]
skills = ["Audit", "audit", "lint"]
mcp = ["files"]
[loadouts.bare]
[defaults]
loadout = "review"

loadouts.name: a named loadout yields exactly its own, whatever the default
an overlay no longer in [overlays] is reported missing, not applied
with no loadouts and no default a session starts with everything the profile lists
with loadouts but no default and none named a session starts with everything the profile lists
a name the file does not hold is refused with the name
a default that names no loadout refuses the file
a loadout with a key it does not have refuses the file
a skill name that climbs out refuses the file

presets.name: a preset holds its source, model, effort, mode, starting instructions, cache lifetime and loadout

presets.name: a preset is the session layer: it wins over the person's own values and leaves the rest as they are
presets keep the file's order and a preset may hold nothing
a name may read as words
a loadout the file no longer holds is not refused
a key a preset does not have refuses the file
an account is not a preset's to name
a value that is not text refuses the file
an empty value refuses the file
a cache lifetime that is not one of the four refuses the file
a name of more than letters, digits, spaces, - _ and ., or one that begins or ends with a space, refuses the file
a preset that is not a table refuses the file
a name with a space at its end refuses the file
